x=pd.concat(all,ignore_index=True)

print('positive >500',x.loc[(~x.cancelled)&(x.raw>500),['carrier','date','sched_dep','actual_dep','sched_dep_utc','actual_dep_utc','raw']].to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, glob
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 utc='sched_dep_utc' in d.columns
 datecol='date_utc' if utc else 'date'; scol='sched_dep_utc' if utc else 'sched_dep'; acol='actual_dep_utc' if utc else 'actual_dep'
 d=d[(d.cancelled==False)&d[acol].notna()]
 sched=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol].astype(str)+' '+d[scol].astype(str))
 actual=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol].astype(str)+' '+d[acol].astype(str))
 # for local and actual clock earlier, necessarily next day per documentation; UTC too potentially date_utc actual after midnight
 delta=(actual-sched).dt.total_seconds()/60
 delta=delta.where(delta>=0,delta+1440)
 print(f, len(delta), delta.min(), delta.max(), delta.mean(), delta.sum())
 rows.extend(delta.tolist())
print('N',len(rows),'sum',sum(rows),'avg',sum(rows)/len(rows))

import pandas as pd, glob
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 # normalize names (AS UTC still same elapsed local-ish clock values for requested delay)
 sc=[c for c in d.columns if c.startswith('sched_dep')][0]; ac=[c for c in d.columns if c.startswith('actual_dep')][0]
 d['raw']=d[ac].fillna('').map(lambda x: int(x[:2])*60+int(x[3:]) if x else None)-d[sc].map(lambda x:int(x[:2])*60+int(x[3:]))
 rows.append(d)
all=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
print('rows dedup',len(all),'cancel',all.cancelled.sum(),'raw negative distribution',all.loc[~all.cancelled,'raw'].value_counts().sort_index().head(20).to_dict())
print('negative min/max',all.loc[(~all.cancelled)&(all.raw<0),'raw'].min(), all.loc[(~all.cancelled)&(all.raw<0),'raw'].max())
print(all.loc[(~all.cancelled)&(all.raw<-120),['flight_id','date' if 'date' in all else all.columns[1],'sched_dep' if 'sched_dep' in all else sc,ac,'raw']].to_string(index=False))

# using all from prior call
completed=all[~all.cancelled].copy()
completed['delay']=completed.raw.where(completed.raw>=-720,completed.raw+1440)
print('completed',len(completed),'sum',completed.delay.sum(),'avg',completed.delay.mean(),'rounded',round(completed.delay.mean(),1))
print('range',completed.delay.min(),completed.delay.max(),'crossmidnight', (completed.raw<-720).sum())
print('by carrier',completed.assign(carrier=completed.flight_id.str[:2]).groupby('carrier').delay.agg(['count','sum','mean']).to_string())
print('dates null', all[[c for c in all.columns if 'date' in c]].isna().sum())

events.notes: Loaded all six carrier files, deduplicated repeated flight_id records, excluded cancelled flights, and computed actual minus scheduled departure minutes. For departures crossing midnight, adjusted the clock-time difference by +1440 minutes; early departures remained negative. The mean across 1,894 completed flights was 15.4451 minutes, reported to 1 decimal.
